maria (PM): Quick heads-up — Customer X just landed a security review and they want the console to show per-route cost, top-10 error spikes, and traces correlated with `request_id`. Their compliance team also wants the ability to lower trace sampling on demand.
kevin (Infra): +1. Do we have per-route token/tokenized-cost already? we have per-model and per-customer aggregates today.
alex (Eng): Not per-route. We emit route tags in telemetry but there’s no rollup dashboard.
sophia (SRE): We can derive route-level cost from `route` tag + token-count metric, but it will be approximate unless we backfill batching attribution.
josh (Support): Customer X will use dedicated capacity and wants dashboards in Console (not just GH ticket). They asked for an alert when error rate > 3% for 5m.
maria (PM): Acceptance criteria proposal: 1) Dashboard card: per-route 24h cost + 7d trend; 2) Top-10 errors by route with sample payload; 3) Trace link from error to full span with `request_id` deep-link; 4) UI toggle to set sampling multiplier (0.1x, 1x, 5x) per-customer.
kevin (Infra): Feasibility note: sampling toggle needs control-plane signal and inference runtime hook to mark spans. Could be `POST /admin/sampling` to per-customer config.
alex (Eng): Implementation sketch:
```
# pseudo
emit_metric("tokens", tags={"route": route, "customer": cust}, value=token_count)
emit_trace(span, tags={"request_id": req_id, "route": route})
```
Then Console aggregates by `route`.
sophia (SRE): Tracing hook: recommend delta-sampling approach: default low (0.01), ramp to 1.0 when error-rate alert fires, with cooldown. That avoids high cost while giving high-fidelity on incidents.
maria (PM): Good. For the Customer X ask can we scope a preview: MVP = per-route cost card + error spike alert + trace deep-link (no sampling UI). Nice-to-have = sampling UI + payload samples.
josh (Support): Customer will accept preview if we can show per-route cost and a way to inspect a few traces.
kevin (Infra): Timeline ask: can we ship MVP in 3 sprints? Need infra work to add route aggregation, storage keys, and a Console card.
alex (Eng): 3 sprints is tight but possible if we limit rollout to Hosted API only (no Dedicated/private). We can polyfill for Dedicated later.
sophia (SRE): Ops runbook note: when trace ramp triggers, we should throttle to avoid OOM on ingest. Add circuit breaker metrics.
maria (PM): Next steps: @kevin to estimate infra effort; @alex to write a minimal spec for the Console card; @sophia to draft sampling ramp runbook; @josh to coordinate Customer X preview. I'll collect and sync with them next Wed.
ops-bot: Deployed staging dashboard template #templates/route-cost-basic at https://deploys.internal/abc123 :rocket:
kevin (Infra): Estimation: infra ~8d, backend aggregation ~6d, Console card ~5d, e2e + QA ~3d. Total ~22 dev-days -> fits 3 sprints across team if prioritized.
maria (PM): Thanks — uploading spec to https://tickets.internal/PRJ-789 (will ping when done). If anyone has major objections to the acceptance criteria, call them out now. :thumbsup:
alex (Eng): No objections. I'll start a draft PR for data pipeline and mock UI snapshots.
sophia (SRE): Adding one constraint: sampling UI must require audit logs and RBAC gate (security will insist). I'll add to spec.
maria (PM): Noted. Closing loop: schedule 30m sync Fri to align on dependencies. Thanks team :)
